article.headline: Sacramento hosts Los Angeles after Doncic's 42-point game
article.description: Los Angeles Lakers (6-2, fourth in the Western Conference) vs. Sacramento Kings (1-6, 14th in the Western Conference)
article.title: Sacramento hosts Los Angeles after Doncic's 42-point game
article.linkText: Sacramento hosts Los Angeles after Doncic's 42-point game
article.story: Los Angeles Lakers (6-2, fourth in the Western Conference) vs. Sacramento Kings (1-6, 14th in the Western Conference) Sacramento, California; Wednesday, 10 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles plays the Sacramento Kings after Luka Doncic scored 42 points in the Lakers' 138-117 win over the Miami Heat. Sacramento finished 22-60 overall and 14-38 in Western Conference games a season ago. The Kings averaged 111.0 points per game while shooting 46.7% from the field and 34.0% from deep last season. Los Angeles went 53-29 overall and 33-19 in Western Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Lakers shot 50.2% from the field and 35.9% from 3-point range last season. INJURIES: Kings: Ben Simmons: out for season (achilles), Keegan Murray: out (ankle), Maxime Raynaud: out (knee), Dylan Cardwell: out (calf). Lakers: Adou Thiero: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
